dimensions.label: Verified With Exact Evidence
dimensions.description: present claims are VERIFIED with the exact matched excerpt as evidence (never the whole corpus)
dimensions.pass_if: present-claim tests return VERIFIED and the evidence field equals only the matched substring

dimensions.label: Honest Unverified
dimensions.description: absent claims are UNVERIFIED with empty evidence — never stamped VERIFIED
dimensions.pass_if: absent-claim tests return UNVERIFIED with evidence ''

dimensions.label: Negative Claims
dimensions.description: NOT-prefixed claims are FAILED when contradicted by evidence and VERIFIED when absent; never dropped or downgraded
dimensions.pass_if: NOT-present -> FAILED with excerpt; NOT-absent -> VERIFIED with ''; claim count preserved

dimensions.label: Completeness & Order
dimensions.description: every input claim yields exactly one verdict in input order
dimensions.pass_if: mixed/order tests return the same number of verdicts in the same order

dimensions.label: Shape & Style
dimensions.description: verdict dicts have exactly claim/status/evidence keys, status in the enum, stdlib only
dimensions.pass_if: shape tests pass and implementation uses only re/stdlib, signature unchanged
